PR #31101 constructs a strict bicategory whose objects are ∞-categories, morphisms are ∞-functors, and natural transformations are ∞-natural transformations (all defined using the quasicategories model). Using this, certain general theorems about bicategories (later cartesian closed bicategories) specialize to provide theorems about ∞-categories.

If you've worked on bicategories and want to help us apply them to the formal theory of quasicategories join us over the Infinity-Cosmos channel. In particular, we're in the process of scheduling a synchronous meeting to discuss next steps:

#Infinity-Cosmos > time for the formal category theory of quasicategories! @ 💬
